title: Semantics of a Nondeterministic Choice
statement: Let $A$ be a nondeterministic register machine, with oracle, input bit string, and configuration guard $G$ fixed. If the instruction at control state $l$ chooses between $l_1$ and $l_0$, the configuration at $l$ satisfies $G$, and the successor configurations at $l_1$ and $l_0$ satisfy the termination and acceptance semantics for propositions $P_1$ and $P_0$, respectively, then the configuration at $l$ satisfies those semantics for $P_1 \lor P_0$.
hypotheses_covered: The instruction at $l$ chooses between $l_1$ and $l_0$
The successor at $l_1$ has the stated semantics for $P_1$
The successor at $l_0$ has the stated semantics for $P_0$
